notes.title: Patch 1.3.5
notes.content:
Adanue Salutem, alchemists. A quick update is out now resolving a couple of issues found throughout the game.


*Note if you are still experiencing game-crashing errors in combat and previously installed the game prior to update 1.3.0 (August 4th), it is recommended that you reinstall the game/validate the game's files on steam to acquire vital files required to fix this issue.



Fixes

Resolved an Issue where fish wouldn't be added to inventory after fishing
Completing the obstacle course west of the Price household now gives the player the promised items
Addressed an issue where the screen would become permanently dark after a sequence in Hermon


Minor Changes


Gave the player some extra healing flasks for the tutorial battle with Cornelius
Can now use the 'Patch Wounds' ability outside combat
'Patch Wounds' now removes bleeding and poison
The Training Tome and all tomes now teach the 'Patch Wounds' skill
In addition to Orange Juice, root beer now removes poison
Removed the waterfall audio source from inside the abandoned cave near the Price house for game stability
Made the light sources inside Hermon priory brighter at night
Fixed an issue of being able to walk through some railings
Adjusted the names of certain maps in Murdahn
Resolved an issue of the proper battlebacks not appearing on Murdahn maps
Adjusted some quest event timing
Fixed some spelling and grammar mistakes
Rewrote some minor parts of dialogue 
Other minor bug fixes



Balancing


Added a new skill 'Vitalize' which removes all debilitating states from a selected ally
'Vitalize' can only be used by instruments, but can be used outside of combat
Removed the 'Bounce Back' skill from lower level slimes
Made the Cactuar vulnerable to fire and piercing damage
Gave the Cactuar the 'Spiked Skin' ability



Thanks to all who have reported bugs that have allowed us to quickly find and resolve some of these issues.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0
notes.content:
Fixes

 Resolved an Issue causing the game to not launch properly 
Resolved an issue with side-view battlers causing fatal game errors
Fixed an error where events outside of Hermon would repeat themselves


Minor Changes


Added all training weapons to Trakos, and Hermon shops.
Adjusted some enemy placements in battles
Fixed some spelling errors
Added some treasure to the Lafey Maze
Rewrote some dialogue for clarity
Added lights to the Hermon Sewer
Removed duplicate actors inside Lafey Manor
Fixed an issue with chimney clipping
Gave Father Theode a nameplate
Addressed an issue where a quest wouldn't complete
Addressed an issue where certain quest rewards wouldn't appear as claimed.
Addressed an issue where certain objectives wouldn't be marked as completed



Balancing


Made the Tempest take more music damage
Changed elemental attacks to deal magic damage instead of physical damage.
Increased the rate at which enemy attacks scale
Slightly increase enemy DEF scaling rates

notes.title: Blood of The Alchemists is now available!
notes.content:
Out now!
Blood of The Alchemists is now available on Steam. The Calriddian Isles are now open and ready to explore! Be wary though, the Islands can be a dangerous place for the inexperienced. Blood of the Alchemists is a different kind of game than it's predecessor Tales From Evenfall , many new mechanics and gameplay elements make their debut in this title. Because of these new elements, guides will be posted on the community hub diving deeper into the game's mechanics.


Keep your wits about you, and your recipes handy. You'll need them for the journey ahead.


Tweaks and Updates
With Blood of the Alchemist's new mechanics, states, and combat, there are a few things that will need to be balanced soon, and in the future to ensure each alchemy class, and allied class has a fair advantage in combat, and that enemies aren't too punishing.
We'll try to keep all the minor tweaks to one larger update, so that we can post a easy-to-follow patch notes that explains all the changes that have been made. 


Future Content/Roadmap
There were many extra features we wanted to include day-one with Blood of The Alchemists, however, some features had to be removed to ensure a timely release. This doesn't mean that this content is gone, we'd like to add smaller free updates in the future that offer improvements and new features to gameplay.

Keeping future content in mind, there's some special free holiday updates planned for the future. Along with some other exciting ideas for fun content that will add to more characters, enemies, and content to the game.


Not sure where to start? Try a guide.
As we mentioned earlier there will be some guides posted on the community tab explaining certain gameplay mechanics, achievements, tips & tricks, etc... all to help those that need it experience the game the way it was meant to be played.



The world of Edina is open to explore! Get out there and be the best alchemist the world has ever known.
